D: A high school kid sneaks out against his dad's orders to go to his best friend's house party.
P: Serve the snacks when the dance-off starts at the party.
S: the snacks on the kitchen bench at Play's house
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter and honey.
the dance battle in the living room

Baked potato halves scooped and crisped, filled with cheddar and bacon, baked bubbling and topped with sour cream and spring onion. Bake 6 medium potatoes at 200C for 50 minutes until soft. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins inside and out with oil. Bake cut side down for 10 minutes until crisp. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Fill the skins with 200g grated cheddar and the bacon and bake 8 minutes more. Top with sour cream and sliced spring onion.
the dance-off in the lounge room

A long Italian loaf filled with salami, ham, provolone, lettuce, tomato, onion and Italian dressing, cut into thick slices. Split a long Italian loaf. Layer with 100g salami, 150g ham, 100g provolone, shredded iceberg, sliced tomato and onion. Drizzle with oil and red wine vinegar and season. Press, then cut into thick slices.
M: Bilal on the decks all night

Pizza dough stretched thin, sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares and left in the box on the bench. Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and dried oregano. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares and leave in the box on the bench.
Kid's dad waiting up at home

Beef meatloaf glazed with tomato and brown sugar, baked until sticky, sliced thick with buttery mash, green beans and onion gravy. Mix 800g beef mince, a grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Press into a loaf tin. Mix 100ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and spread on top. Bake at 180C for 1 hour. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Steam 300g green beans. Make gravy from the pan juices and a sachet of onion gravy mix.
W: the party that runs all night
Chocolate sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fudge frosting and sprinkles, cut into big squares.
K: the punch bowl in the kitchen

Pineapple and orange juice with passionfruit pulp and lime, topped with lemonade over ice, with frozen pineapple chunks, orange slices and mint floating on top. Freeze 300g pineapple chunks on a tray for 2 hours. In a big bowl, mix 750ml pineapple juice, 500ml orange juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Add a tray of ice and the frozen pineapple. Just before serving, top with 1L cold lemonade and float sliced orange and torn mint on top. Ladle into cups.
